Name: Seeds From Crops
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
Vanilla crops and forage now have a random chance of dropping seeds when eaten.

Drop chances:
[spoiler]
50% for normal seeds.
40% for wild seasonal seeds.
30% for Qi beans.
[/spoiler]

Many crops can drop seeds, tell me if I forgot any.

You get seed packets because that is how seeds look in game.
